test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 10 Feb 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT true regarding the President of India?

options.text: He is the Supreme Commander of the defence forces.
He appoints the Prime Minister and the Council of Ministers.
The President is the first citizen of the nation.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He cannot declare national emergency.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The president is the **Supreme Commander of the Indian Armed Forces**.
 
• The president can **declare war or conclude peace, on the advice of the Union Council of Ministers headed by the prime minister.**
 
• All important
